description: This script automates testing a git-svn integration scenario involving a repository with deleted and readded directories. It loads an SVN repository dump, initializes svnserve, and performs svn fetch operations, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that svnserve is running before proceeding with tests.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the svnserve process for SVN repository access.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, used for setup and verification steps.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test specification.
